 Oral Judgment
Learned counsel for the appellant prays for time.
2.

Order sheet dated 15.10.2025 reads as under:
"Learned counsel for the appellant prays for time.
Office has raised as many as 14 objections.
Inspite of the same, the office objections are not complied with and also the court fee is not paid, even though the matter is listed for non-compliance of office objections for fourth time.
I do not find any reason to adjourn the matter.

However, to afford final opportunity, as a last chance, list this matter on 05.11.2025."
3.
The matter is listed for fifth time for compliance of office objections.
None of the office objections have been complied with and there is no progress in the matter.
It appears that the appellant is not interested in prosecuting the matter.
Hence, the appeal is dismissed for default i.e., for non-prosecution.
